title: A calcium–phosphate interaction failed to improve grip-strength prediction across NHANES survey waves
abstract: A sex-specific calcium-by-phosphate interaction was added to flexible separate mineral, renal, albumin and anthropometric models. NHANES2011–12 supplied 4148 source adults and NHANES2013–14 supplied 4616 target adults. Target weighted MSE increased by 0.303392 kg² (conditional target PSU95% interval [0.06485107667071795, 0.5650448773087275]; two-wave full-refit95% interval [-1.0055298176227854, 12.642813388275556]). Source grouped cross-validation also worsened. This fixed interaction did not establish incremental prediction; no equivalence, absence of mineral-related information, causal effect or clinical utility is established. Validation outside NHANES remains unperformed.
